rounds.prompt: How many kiwifruit would it take to weigh as much as an adult North Island brown kiwi?
rounds.source: New Zealand Birds Online (Te Papa and Birds New Zealand), North Island brown kiwi: 2 kg male, 2.7 kg female · Zespri, average Green kiwifruit weight of 92.5 g

rounds.prompt: How many cigarettes are smoked worldwide every day?
rounds.source: The Tobacco Atlas (Vital Strategies and Economics for Health): more than 5 trillion cigarettes smoked worldwide in 2019
rounds.qualifier: Counting factory-made cigarettes, not hand-rolled ones.

rounds.prompt: How many people live north of the Arctic Circle?
rounds.source: Nordregio (2018), Arctic settlements of 500+ people in 2017, summed for every town north of the Arctic Circle (66°34'N)
